mapper.sql: u.user_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND u.user_type_cd = 301 AND u.user_id LIKE 'bot!_%' ESCAPE '!'
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_sq AS userSq, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, (SELECT r.resume_sq FROM TBL_RESUME_M r WHERE r.user_sq = u.user_sq AND r.resume_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY r.resume_is_representative_yn DESC, r.resume_sq LIMIT 1) AS resumeSq FROM TBL_USER_M u WHERE ORDER BY u.user_sq

SELECT a.project_sq AS projectSq, r.user_sq AS userSq FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a JOIN TBL_RESUME_M r ON r.resume_sq = a.resume_sq
WHERE a.project_sq IN #{sq}
